provenance.note: Place name on the river, geocoded to the reach [supplied on this invocation]
Steady upstream CARRIER discharge - the river flow that dilutes and transports the release [supplied on this invocation]
Result-writing cadence; unset keeps the steering file's own period [supplied on this invocation]

Where the discharge enters the water, as a Point: the pick's {coordinates, name} verbatim, a (lon, lat) pair, 'lat,lon', a point layer, or a place name; unset seeds the reach at the derived reach point [supplied on this invocation]

Ultimate carbonaceous BOD IN THE DISCHARGE ITSELF - what leaves the outfall pipe, before any dilution; the reach's mixed load is what the solve computes from this and the carrier flow [supplied on this invocation]
Discharge rate at the outfall - with the carrier flow this sets the dilution, and so how much of the effluent load the river carries [supplied on this invocation]
Water temperature, which sets the DO saturation the deficit is measured against; 20 C is the standard Streeter-Phelps condition [supplied on this invocation]
The DO water-quality standard the sag is judged against; 5 is a common warm-water aquatic-life criterion [supplied on this invocation]
CBOD deoxygenation rate - a documented rate coefficient [supplied on this invocation]
Surface reaeration rate - a documented rate coefficient [supplied on this invocation]
Modeled reach length downstream of the discharge; the sag critical point is often several km down [supplied on this invocation]

Simulated time. A sag is a STEADY-STATE answer, so this has to cover several travel times through the reach AND be long against 1/k1 - a window shorter than that reports a sag that has not developed yet [supplied on this invocation]
Target element edge length the reach is triangulated at; where the sag bottoms out is a local feature and moves with the element that resolves it [supplied on this invocation]
Solve sizing class [declared constant default]
Dissolved oxygen in the discharge itself; a treated effluent arrives oxygen-poor, which is the initial deficit the sag starts from [declared scenario default]
DO saturation Cs; derived from water temperature unless supplied [derived by trid3nt_server.workflows.telemac.helpers.water_quality.do_saturation_mgl]
DO carried in at the top of the reach; derived as saturation unless supplied [derived by trid3nt_server.workflows.telemac.helpers.water_quality.upstream_do_mgl]
not supplied; the reach flowline is fetched fresh for the AOI
not supplied; the carrier discharge is read at the MOST RECENT published NWM cycle
not supplied; the reach is solved at Strickler 33.0, which is also the roughness its outflow stage is derived as a normal depth at
not supplied; the coefficient is read as a Strickler one
